name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Advice Practice for Claude Code: what needs attention, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Ongoing fee consents
sections.note: Lapsed arrangements must stop charging. Open windows closing inside 60 days need a signed consent.
sections.sql: select reference, client, adviser, annual_fee, currency, terminates_on, window_state, days_left from consent_windows where window_state = 'lapsed' or (window_state = 'open' and days_left <= 60 and (last_consent is null or last_consent < window_opens)) order by terminates_on

sections.title: Reviews overdue
sections.note: A client paying an ongoing fee with no review is the fee-for-no-service problem.
sections.sql: select reference, name, adviser, service_package, due_on, days_overdue, pays_ongoing_fee from review_schedule where days_overdue > 0 order by days_overdue desc

sections.title: Open complaints
sections.sql: select k.reference, c.name as client, c.jurisdiction, k.received_on, k.acknowledged_on, current_date - k.received_on as days_open, k.summary from complaints k join clients c on c.id = k.client_id where k.responded_on is null order by k.received_on

sections.title: Compliance findings
sections.note: Each rule and its source is in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule, record, client, finding from compliance_findings order by severity, rule, record

name: fee-book
title: Fee book
subtitle: Ongoing fee revenue by adviser, and what is at risk

sections.title: By adviser
sections.sql: select coalesce(w.adviser, '(none)') as adviser, w.currency, count(*)::int as arrangements, sum(w.annual_fee) as annual_fees, coalesce(sum(w.annual_fee) filter (where w.window_state = 'lapsed'), 0) as lapsed, coalesce(sum(w.annual_fee) filter (where r.days_overdue > 30), 0) as review_overdue from consent_windows w join fee_arrangements f on f.id = w.id left join review_schedule r on r.id = f.client_id group by 1, 2 order by 2, 1

sections.title: Every arrangement
sections.sql: select reference, client, adviser, annual_fee, currency, reference_day, terminates_on, window_state, last_consent from consent_windows order by adviser, terminates_on

name: pipeline
title: Advice pipeline
subtitle: Every statement of advice and advice record still in progress

sections.title: In progress
sections.sql: select reference, client, adviser, topic, document_kind, stage, days_in_stage, prepared_by, advice_fee from advice_pipeline order by array_position(array['fact find','research','drafting','compliance check','presented'], stage), days_in_stage desc

sections.title: CPD this year
sections.sql: select code, name, jurisdiction, cpd_year_ends, days_left, total_hours, technical, client_care, regulatory, ethics from cpd_progress order by days_left
